text.优先抓自带光环的恶魔（光环对全队生效，等于白嫖一个增益位），其次选血厚攻高的近战: The supplied route favors an aura-carrying demon where capture rules allow, otherwise a durable melee demon. One-point Bind cannot capture higher-tier targets; revisit those after investing more following the respec.
text.眼光为什么自己拿，不给佣兵？: Why wield Insight yourself instead of giving it to the mercenary?
text.这个流派的输出在你自己手上：长柄面板直接决定回响伤害，冥思光环也要贴身才稳。佣兵: Your weapon supplies this build's damage, so the polearm's listed damage matters directly. Keep Meditation with you while an Act II Offensive mercenary provides Might for you and the demons.
text.洗点转纯招后，这身装备白做了吗？: Is the leveling gear wasted after the pure-summon respec?
text.不白做。烟雾（+50 全抗）和知识（+1 技能）转纯招照样能穿；钢铁、力量、眼光: No. Smoke and Lore remain useful. Steel, Strength and Insight are temporary weapons made from low-to-mid runes, and the route values the progression time they save.
text.高速开荒回响恶魔流 · 暗黑破坏神 II：重制版术士开荒路线（3.4 补丁 /: Fast Leveling: Echoing Strike & Demons · Supplied Diablo II: Resurrected Warlock route for Patch 3.4 / Season 16. Gameplay and event claims are reproduced from the source guide and are not automatically updated for later seasons.
text.符文号数按游戏内编号标注；恶魔只数以「硬点」为准——装备与护符加的技能等级不计入: Rune numbers use the game's standard numbering. Demon-count unlocks use hard points, excluding skill bonuses from gear and charms. The cover is concept art, not an in-game screenshot.
text.术士悬浮一把回响残影环绕的双手大剑，三只羊头恶魔持盾在他身前结成盾墙: A Warlock levitates a two-handed sword surrounded by echoes while three shield-bearing Goatmen form a wall in front of him

calculator.stage: Stage 1 · Start levitating — establish your own damage with one Goatman tanking.
calculator.skill: Levitation Mastery: 1 → prioritize Echoing Strike; one prerequisite point each in Summon Goatman and Cleave.
calculator.attr: Enough Strength for your two-hander, the rest in Vitality. Zero Energy.
calculator.gear: Your strongest listed-damage two-hander; wear Stealth when available and make Steel at level 13.
calculator.task: Progress through Normal and farm Countess for Tir (#3) and El (#1).

calculator.stage: Stage 2 · Second demon — reach 5 hard points in Demonic Mastery.
calculator.skill: Keep building Echoing Strike; 5 hard points in Demonic Mastery, with one-point Summon Tainted and Eldritch Blast prerequisites.
calculator.attr: Meet new weapon Strength requirements; put the rest in Vitality.
calculator.gear: Upgrade to Strength (Amn #11 + Tir #3) for Crushing Blow against bosses.
calculator.task: Farm missing runes and finish the first half of Normal.

calculator.stage: Stage 3 · Three demons and defenses — 10 hard points in Mastery, plus mobility, ward and damage sharing.
calculator.skill: Stop Demonic Mastery at 10 hard points. One point each in Blade Warp, Psychic Ward, Blood Oath, Death Mark and Summon Defiler. Follow maxed Echoing Strike with Mirrored Blades.
calculator.attr: Enough Strength for gear; the rest in Vitality for a larger margin of error.
calculator.gear: Stealth for movement, Lore (Ort #9 + Sol #12) for +1 skills, and your strongest available weapon.
calculator.task: Finish Normal and unlock your defensive skills before Nightmare.

calculator.stage: Stage 4 · Bind and Mirrored Blades — one-point Bind Demon at level 30 and pack-clearing damage.
calculator.skill: One point in Bind Demon; max Mirrored Blades. One-point Sigil: Lethargy for bosses and Hex: Siphon for sustain.
calculator.attr: Enough Strength for gear; the rest in Vitality. Let Insight handle mana rather than investing in Energy.
calculator.gear: Wield Insight yourself (Ral #8 + Tir #3 + Tal #7 + Sol #12); use an Act II Offensive mercenary.
calculator.task: Find a suitable polearm in Cows, verify its socket count for Larzuk, and farm Nightmare Countess for missing runes.

calculator.stage: Stage 5 · Nightmare upgrades — add utility and resists before the planned pure-summon respec.
calculator.skill: One point each in Blood Boil and Engorge. Add remaining points to Levitation Mastery and Blood Oath.
calculator.attr: Enough Strength for gear; the rest in Vitality. Check all four resistances before Hell.
calculator.gear: Smoke (Nef #4 + Lum #17, +50 all resistances) and resistance pieces from Nightmare Mephisto.
calculator.task: Defeat Nightmare Baal around level 60–65, then use Nightmare Akara's respec for pure summons.
